name: Hrubieszów (Poland)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, red above and green below, with a white stag's head from the city arms and the date 1400 in the upper hoist.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: stag's head from the city arms above the date 1400
